nodes.text: explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): Use one explore sub-agent to inspect both task-provided survey-methodology pages in read-only mode and combine their source-backed guidance with the frozen local-reference packet supplied by the main agent. Use only the granted non-interactive browser navigation, snapshot, search, and wait operations; do not click, type, evaluate scripts, select options, invoke terminal, or reread workspace files. Return a compact source-referenced methodology packet covering comparison criteria, taxonomy guidance, recommended presentation structure, slide tips, and per-page/reference coverage. Do not write deliverables or alter the pages.

explore 1 (academic-literature-researcher 0): Use one explore sub-agent to scout the task-relevant local arXiv candidate space read-only for recent NLP, language-model, and reasoning papers. Use complementary queries at the supported per-call result bound, union and deduplicate by stable ID because no search cursor is exposed, validate relevance from title/abstract, and return a candidate manifest with authors/date, abstract, available arxiv-latex status, per-query/union controls, and rejected distractors. Do not read full manuscripts, write files, or create deliverables.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one coder sub-agent to own `<workspace_root>/Survey_Data.xlsx` exclusively. Use one `python_execute` with `openpyxl` to create Paper Comparison, Taxonomy, and Summary Statistics atomically from the canonical payload with exact headers, standard IDs without prefix/version, literal Value cells, source-backed method/dataset/finding rows, and verified taxonomy/statistics. Then read each complete populated range once and return path, sheet order, row/metric controls, and validation. Do not write the presentation.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): Use one coder sub-agent to own `<workspace_root>/NLP_Survey.pptx` exclusively. Use one `python_execute` with `python-pptx` to create the complete deck atomically from the canonical payload, with at least six slides including a title slide, methodology slide grounded in the webpage/guide packet, at least three distinct paper slides, and a final taxonomy/trends summary. Follow the visible style guide, then read the deck once and return path, slide count/titles, paper/methodology coverage, and validation. Do not write the workbook.
